comment: Written by the daily sweep routine. It fires hourly from 08:00 Europe/Madrid and stops as soon as last_success matches today, so a failed run gets retried and a finished one does not repeat. Every create path (gh CLI, curl, GitHub MCP) appends a Claude Code footer to pull request bodies and comments, which this repo does not carry. Strip it afterwards with the MCP update calls (update_pull_request, update_issue_comment); those do not re-append. Verify the tail with curl.
